title: Canonical stratum internal-adjunction and coefficient-comparison maps
statement: Use ordinary unbounded derived categories of constant-ring module sheaves on small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], derived scalar extension $F_T=-\otimes_A^LB$ for a commutative ring map $\phi:A\to B$ [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], and derived internal Hom $H_A$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. Let $g:Z\hookrightarrow X$ be closed [def-weil-closed-immersion] and $j:S\hookrightarrow Z$ open [def-weil-open-immersion]. For a finite commutative coefficient ring $R$ define $s_{!,R}=Rg_*j_!$ [def-amb-etale-compact-support], $s_{*,R}=Rg_*Rj_*$, and $s_R^!=j^*Rg^!$ using the ambient closed right adjoint [lem-exc-closed-ambient]. Define $\epsilon_s:s_!s^!\to1$ as the pasted exceptional counit, and $\eta_s:s^*s_*\to1$ as the pasted ordinary counit. For $L\in D(S,R)$ and $T\in D(X,R)$ define $\pi:s_!L\otimes_R^LT\to s_!(L\otimes_R^Ls^*T)$ by the closed proper projection followed by the inverse open projection [def-kun-projection-formula-map] [lem-coef-etale-open-tensor]. Define $I_R:s_*H_R(L,s^!M)\to H_R(s_!L,M)$ as the tensor–Hom transpose of $\pi$ followed by $s_!(1\otimes\eta_s)$, $s_!\operatorname{ev}$, and $\epsilon_s$. Define the compact scalar map $q_{s,L}=c_{g,j_!L};Rg_*(q_{j,L})$ using the canonical open scalar isomorphism; define the ordinary scalar map $c_{s,Q}=c_{g,Rj_*Q};Rg_*(c_{j,Q})$, where each $c_f$ is the ordinary-counit scalar comparison [lem-coef-finite-direct-image]. Define $v_{K,M}:F_TH_A(K,M)\to H_B(F_TK,F_TM)$ as the transpose of the canonical scalar/tensor identification followed by $F_T\operatorname{ev}$. For a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, define $A_n=\mathcal O_E/(\varpi_E^n)$ for $n\ge1$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], with the standard universe lift, its inherited finiteness instance, and for $m\le n$ define $A_n\to A_m$ as the quotient factor map of the uniformizer-power ideals. These are constructions of arrows, without assertions of their invertibility or of their compatibility. Semicolon denotes composition in the written order.

def internalAdjunction (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (g : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion g] (j : S ⟶ Z) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (L : DerivedCategoryModule A S) (M : DerivedCategoryModule A X) :
    (star A g j).obj
        (((derivedHom (ModuleCat A) S).obj (op L)).obj ((exceptional A g j).obj M)) ⟶
      ((derivedHom (ModuleCat A) X).obj (op ((shriek A g j).obj L))).obj M
